notes.content: Watch us play an early build of Frogreign!

notes.title: 🐸 Frogreign is part of the PixElated Festival! 🐸
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398305/f8f184abbd7fc61998a00f6d8f188295a315f461.gif[/img]
Hey Frogs,

We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 

We’re super excited to share that Frogreign joins PixElated Festival next week! We will be running extra development livestreams during the event, and may also have some surprise content!

This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. 
There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: [url=http://pixelatedfest.com/]http://pixelatedfest.com/[/url]
